rubric_items.reason: Built on existing layers and modules and now uses the injected service clock (F-1 resolved), but still does not reuse the existing NextAppointment type for visits.next and visits.last.
Every story S-1..S-6 is mapped to components, and the field rules (status filters, starts_at > now, counts over all dates, zone from useSettings, link to /appointments/:id) cover each AC.
Every new field has name, type, nullability, format and example; the tie-break for latest COMPLETED is still not stated, so ties are not exactly testable.
Choices are cited or decided by A-01..A-03 and the clock is now proven by C18/C19; the id fields stay Assumed on an indirect basis though product types prove them.
Trade-offs cover server-side visits, the injected clock with its testing benefit, warning style and privacy.
Clear and consistent; front matter and body agree.
